parameters.name: EndDateAfter
parameters.description: Filters task executions whose end time is later than or equal to the specified time.

parameters.name: EndDateBefore
parameters.description: Filters task executions whose end time is earlier than or equal to the specified time.

parameters.name: IncludeChildTaskExecution
parameters.description: Specifies whether to display child tasks generated by a loop. Default value: False.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 20 to 100. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: ParentTaskExecutionId
parameters.description: The parent task execution ID. This parameter is used in loop scenarios and is typically set to the TaskExecutionId of the loop parent.

parameters.name: SortField
parameters.description:
The field used for sorting. Valid values:
- **StartDate** (default): the creation time.
- **EndDate**: the end time.
- **Status**: the status.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:
- **Ascending**: ascending order.
- **Descending** (default): descending order.

parameters.name: StartDateAfter
parameters.description: Filters task executions whose start time is later than or equal to the specified time.

parameters.name: StartDateBefore
parameters.description: Filters task executions whose start time is earlier than or equal to the specified time.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The execution status. Valid values: Running, Started, Success, Failed, Waiting, Cancelled, Pending, Skipped.
